notes.title: Nominate The Wonderful One: After School Hero in the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277503/c1b073ee71ec4c05cf6375eacbee58efe3d2eae2.jpg[/img]

Steam Deck is your perfect companion for [i][b]The Wonderful One: After School Hero[/b][/i]! Play the game anywhere and anytime on the go! Try beating one level in your spare time, take on the 5-minute high score challenge in Caravan Mode, or take turns playing with friends to compete for the best scores.

Please support us by taking the time to nominate [i][b]The Wonderful One: After School Hero[/b][/i] for the “Best Game on Steam Deck” category in the Steam Awards 2023 during the Autumn Sale!

[b]Nomination period:[/b] 10am November 21 – 10am November 28 (Pacific Time)
